from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u078/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    common = {v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)}
    marker_colors = set(counts) - common
    if not marker_colors:
        return [[counts.most_common(1)[0][0]]]

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] in marker_colors for c in range(w))]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in marker_colors for r in range(h))]
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [[next(iter(marker_colors))]]

    nodes = [[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] in marker_colors else None for c in cols] for r in rows]
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[fill for _ in range(len(cols)-1)] for _ in range(len(rows)-1)]
    for color in marker_colors:
        for r0 in range(len(rows)-1):
            for r1 in range(r0+1, len(rows)):
                for c0 in range(len(cols)-1):
                    for c1 in range(c0+1, len(cols)):
                        if (all(nodes[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1+1)) and
                            all(nodes[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1+1)) and
                            all(nodes[r][c0] == color for r in range(r0, r1+1)) and
                            all(nodes[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1+1))):
                            for r in range(r0, r1):
                                for c in range(c0, c1):
                                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-ce20be4c.py'
path.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(path), 'exec'))
print(path)
